item.title: k8s: From Working Group to SIG Architecture: spotlight on AI Conformance
item.description:
Kubernetes moved AI Conformance from a temporary Working Group into a permanent SIG Architecture subproject after establishing the initial requirements and certification process. The change is meant to keep AI infrastructure requirements vendor-neutral and aligned with Kubernetes architecture as AI workloads become more common.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: k8s: Announcing the Workload Conformance Working Group
item.description:
Kubernetes announced a new Workload Conformance Working Group to define a shared, testable standard for workload behavior at runtime. The group will produce a per-minor-version specification, objective tests, and upstream conformance tooling, with initial coverage focused on runtime behavior rather than application logic.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog
